title: Two Seals on the Caldera Seam

hook.rumour: Along the Odai River in Balmora, Hlaalu council clerks and Moonmoth Legion officers trade accusations over missing raw ebony shipments from Caldera while Camonna Tong toughs watch from the cornerclubs.
hook.notice: HLAALU COUNCIL MANOR, BALMORA — Investigators commissioned to audit the missing ebony tallies between Balmora, Caldera, and Moonmoth Legion Fort.
hook.context: The West Gash is House Hlaalu's commercial heartland: Imperial charter-towns at Caldera and Legion forts at Moonmoth enrich Balmora's nobles while feeding bitter nationalist resentment.

stages.objective: Inspect the disputed assay books at Hlaalu Council Manor in Balmora
Verify the Imperial escort logs with the knight-captain at Moonmoth Legion Fort
Question the magistrate's clerks inside the Tudor guild-hall at Caldera

objectives.text: Inspect the disputed assay books at Hlaalu Council Manor in Balmora
Verify the Imperial escort logs with the knight-captain at Moonmoth Legion Fort
Question the magistrate's clerks inside the Tudor guild-hall at Caldera

consequence_detail.summary: Comparing Balmora, Moonmoth, and Caldera records proves every third ebony wain was diverted down the western trail toward Hla Oad.

stages.objective: Inspect the hidden ore-chute at Caldera Mine and question the night-shift foreman
Check the Odai river-barge moorings below Rethan Manor
Intercept the smuggler skiff crew at the stilts of Hla Oad

objectives.text: Inspect the hidden ore-chute at Caldera Mine and question the night-shift foreman
Check the Odai river-barge moorings below Rethan Manor
Intercept the smuggler skiff crew at the stilts of Hla Oad

consequence_detail.summary: The smuggler skiff at Hla Oad is seized, revealing that the stolen ebony is stored inside the stronghold of Hlormaren and Bthanchend.

stages.objective: Storm the coastal stronghold of Hlormaren and defeat the syndicate factor's guards
Recover the stamped Imperial ebony ingots hidden inside the Dwemer gallery at Bthanchend
Deliver the recovered ingots to the Hlaalu escrow post at Odai Plateau

objectives.text: Storm the coastal stronghold of Hlormaren and defeat the syndicate factor's guards
Recover the stamped Imperial ebony ingots hidden inside the Dwemer gallery at Bthanchend
Deliver the recovered ingots to the Hlaalu escrow post at Odai Plateau

consequence_detail.summary: The stolen Caldera ebony ingots are recovered from Hlormaren and Bthanchend and placed under guard at Odai Plateau.

stages.objective: File the restored assay rolls at the Magistrate's Hall in Caldera
Present the signed Caldera-Balmora Assay Compact at Hlaalu Council Manor in Balmora
Receive your factor's share and title on the bridges of Balmora

objectives.text: File the restored assay rolls at the Magistrate's Hall in Caldera
Present the signed Caldera-Balmora Assay Compact at Hlaalu Council Manor in Balmora
Receive your factor's share and title on the bridges of Balmora

consequence_detail.summary: Honest pay and audited ore-weighing resume at Caldera Mine, and Balmora's Council Manor honors you as Factor-Inspector of the Odai.
